stem:
Kavya tests a colourless unknown liquid X with three indicators.

Blue litmus paper — turns red
Red litmus paper — stays red
Turmeric solution — stays yellow

Which claims are justified by combining all the indicator evidence? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Turmeric staying yellow agrees with an acidic classification.
Liquid X is basic, so the blue-litmus result can be ignored.
Liquid X cannot be classified until every possible indicator has been tested.

teacher.key_rationale: Blue litmus turning red and red litmus staying red justify an acidic label; unchanged turmeric agrees with acid. Ignoring conflicting litmus or demanding every indicator is unjustified.
